name: NO ENTRY
description: Solid red circle with a horizontal white bar.
meaning: Vehicles are not allowed to enter the road from the direction the sign faces.
instruction: Entry of vehicles is prohibited.
rules: Usually placed at the exit of a one-way street. Entering is a punishable offence and a collision risk.

name: NO PARKING
description: Blue circle with a red border and one red diagonal bar.
meaning: Parking of vehicles is not permitted in this stretch of road.
instruction: Parking is not allowed in this area.
rules: Stopping briefly to load/unload passengers may be allowed; leaving the vehicle parked can lead to a fine or towing.

name: NO STOPPING
description: Blue circle with a red border and a red cross.
meaning: Vehicles must not stop or wait here, even for a moment.
instruction: Do not stop your vehicle in this area.
rules: Stopping is allowed only in an emergency or when directed by police/traffic signals.

name: NO U-TURN
description: Red-bordered circle with a black U-turn arrow crossed by a red bar.
meaning: Vehicles are not allowed to make a U-turn at this location.
instruction: U-turn is prohibited; continue straight or find a designated turning point.
rules: U-turns near junctions and on busy roads cause accidents and are punishable.

name: NO LEFT TURN
description: Red-bordered circle with a left-turn arrow crossed by a red bar.
meaning: Turning left is not permitted at the next junction.
instruction: Do not turn left at this junction.
rules: Follow the alternate route shown by other signs.

name: NO RIGHT TURN
description: Red-bordered circle with a right-turn arrow crossed by a red bar.
meaning: Turning right is not permitted at the next junction.
instruction: Do not turn right at this junction.
rules: Follow the alternate route shown by other signs.

name: NO OVERTAKING
description: Red-bordered circle with a black car beside a red car.
meaning: Overtaking other vehicles is prohibited on this stretch of road.
instruction: Do not overtake other vehicles in this zone.
rules: Applies at curves, bridges and hill crests where visibility is limited.

name: HORN PROHIBITED
description: Red-bordered circle with a horn symbol crossed by a red bar.
meaning: Sounding the horn is not allowed in this area.
instruction: Do not use the horn in this area.
rules: Usually placed near hospitals, schools, courts and silence zones.

name: SPEED LIMIT 20
description: Red-bordered circle showing the number 20.
meaning: Maximum speed limit of 20 km/h applies.
instruction: Maximum permitted speed is 20 km/h.
rules: Common near schools and crowded areas. Exceeding the limit is punishable.

name: SPEED LIMIT 30
description: Red-bordered circle showing the number 30.
meaning: Maximum speed limit of 30 km/h applies.
instruction: Maximum permitted speed is 30 km/h.
rules: Common in residential and market areas. Exceeding the limit is punishable.

name: SPEED LIMIT 40
description: Red-bordered circle showing the number 40.
meaning: Maximum speed limit of 40 km/h applies.
instruction: Maximum permitted speed is 40 km/h.
rules: Drive at or below the limit; reduce speed further in bad weather.

name: SPEED LIMIT 50
description: Red-bordered circle showing the number 50.
meaning: Maximum speed limit of 50 km/h applies.
instruction: Maximum permitted speed is 50 km/h.
rules: Typical urban limit. Exceeding the limit is punishable.

name: SPEED LIMIT 60
description: Red-bordered circle showing the number 60.
meaning: Maximum speed limit of 60 km/h applies.
instruction: Maximum permitted speed is 60 km/h.
rules: Drive at or below the limit; keep a safe following distance.

name: SPEED LIMIT 70
description: Red-bordered circle showing the number 70.
meaning: Maximum speed limit of 70 km/h applies.
instruction: Maximum permitted speed is 70 km/h.
rules: Exceeding the limit is punishable; slow down for junctions and crossings.

name: SPEED LIMIT 80
description: Red-bordered circle showing the number 80.
meaning: Maximum speed limit of 80 km/h applies.
instruction: Maximum permitted speed is 80 km/h.
rules: Typical highway limit. Exceeding the limit is punishable.

name: SPEED LIMIT 100
description: Red-bordered circle showing the number 100.
meaning: Maximum speed limit of 100 km/h applies.
instruction: Maximum permitted speed is 100 km/h.
rules: Expressway limit; lower limits apply to heavy vehicles and in bad weather.

name: TRUCKS PROHIBITED
description: Red-bordered circle with a black truck.
meaning: Entry of heavy goods vehicles (trucks) is prohibited.
instruction: Trucks must not enter this road.
rules: Often applies at certain hours in city areas. Use the designated truck route.

name: PEDESTRIANS PROHIBITED
description: Red-bordered circle with a walking person crossed by a red bar.
meaning: Pedestrians are not allowed on this road or stretch.
instruction: Pedestrians must not walk on this road.
rules: Common on expressways and bridges. Use the footpath or subway provided.

name: CYCLES PROHIBITED
description: Red-bordered circle with a black bicycle.
meaning: Bicycles are not allowed on this road.
instruction: Cyclists must not enter this road.
rules: Cyclists should use the alternate route or cycle track.

name: ALL VEHICLES PROHIBITED
description: Empty white circle with a red border.
meaning: No vehicle of any type may pass this point in either direction.
instruction: No vehicles are allowed beyond this point.
rules: Often used for pedestrian zones, markets or closed roads.

name: WIDTH LIMIT
description: Red-bordered circle with horizontal arrows between bars and '2.5m'.
meaning: Vehicles wider than 2.5 metres are not allowed.
instruction: Do not enter if your vehicle is wider than 2.5 m.
rules: Applies to narrow roads, bridges and tunnels.

name: HEIGHT LIMIT
description: Red-bordered circle with vertical arrows between bars and '3.5m'.
meaning: Vehicles taller than 3.5 metres are not allowed.
instruction: Do not enter if your vehicle is taller than 3.5 m.
rules: Applies to low bridges, tunnels and overhead cables.

name: WEIGHT LIMIT
description: Red-bordered circle with the text '10T'.
meaning: Vehicles with a gross weight above 10 tonnes are not allowed.
instruction: Do not proceed if your vehicle weighs more than 10 tonnes.
rules: Applies to weak bridges and light-duty roads.

name: SPEED LIMIT 110
description: Red-bordered circle showing the number 110.
meaning: Maximum speed limit of 110 km/h applies.
instruction: Maximum permitted speed is 110 km/h.
rules: Common on expressways. Exceeding the limit is punishable; lower limits apply to heavy vehicles.

name: SPEED LIMIT 120
description: Red-bordered circle showing the number 120.
meaning: Maximum speed limit of 120 km/h applies.
instruction: Maximum permitted speed is 120 km/h.
rules: Found on highways and expressways. Exceeding the limit is punishable.

name: MOTORCYCLES PROHIBITED
description: Red-bordered circle with a motorcycle silhouette.
meaning: Motorcycles and two-wheelers are not allowed on this road.
instruction: Motorcycles must not enter this road.
rules: Cyclists should use the alternate designated route.

name: ANIMALS PROHIBITED
description: Red-bordered circle with an animal silhouette crossed by a red bar.
meaning: Animal-drawn vehicles and livestock are not permitted on this road.
instruction: Do not bring animals or animal-drawn carts onto this road.
rules: Common on expressways and high-speed roads where animals pose a safety hazard.

name: HEAVY VEHICLES PROHIBITED
description: Red-bordered circle with a heavy vehicle silhouette.
meaning: Heavy or overloaded vehicles are not allowed to proceed.
instruction: Heavy vehicles must not enter this road.
rules: Applies near bridges, tunnels and roads with load restrictions.

name: END OF SPEED LIMIT
description: Grey circle with a diagonal grey bar and the number 0.
meaning: The previously posted speed restriction is lifted here.
instruction: Speed restriction ends; resume normal safe speed for road conditions.
rules: Drive at a speed appropriate for the road conditions; other limits may still apply.

name: TURN LEFT AHEAD
description: Blue circle with a white left-turn arrow.
meaning: Vehicles must turn left ahead.
instruction: Turn left at the junction ahead.
rules: Follow the direction indicated; do not go straight or turn right.

name: TURN RIGHT AHEAD
description: Blue circle with a white right-turn arrow.
meaning: Vehicles must turn right ahead.
instruction: Turn right at the junction ahead.
rules: Follow the direction indicated; do not go straight or turn left.

name: AHEAD ONLY
description: Blue circle with a white upward arrow.
meaning: Vehicles must proceed straight ahead only.
instruction: Go straight; turning is not allowed.
rules: Left and right turns are not permitted at this junction.

name: KEEP LEFT
description: Blue circle with a white arrow pointing down-left.
meaning: Vehicles must keep to the left side of the obstruction or divider.
instruction: Keep to the left.
rules: Pass the island/divider on its left side.

name: KEEP RIGHT
description: Blue circle with a white arrow pointing down-right.
meaning: Vehicles must keep to the right side of the obstruction or divider.
instruction: Keep to the right.
rules: Pass the island/divider on its right side.

name: ROUNDABOUT
description: Blue circle with three white arrows going round.
meaning: A roundabout (traffic circle) lies ahead; traffic circulates in the indicated direction.
instruction: Enter the roundabout and move in the direction shown.
rules: Give way to vehicles already on the roundabout; signal before exiting.

name: COMPULSORY HORN
description: Blue circle with a white horn.
meaning: Drivers must sound the horn here (blind curves/hill roads).
instruction: Sound your horn.
rules: Warns oncoming traffic around blind corners; use one short honk.

name: CYCLE TRACK
description: Blue circle with a white bicycle.
meaning: This lane/track is reserved for bicycles only.
instruction: Only cycles may use this track.
rules: Motor vehicles must not enter or park on the cycle track.

name: PEDESTRIANS ONLY
description: Blue circle with a white walking person.
meaning: This path is reserved for pedestrians.
instruction: Only pedestrians may use this path.
rules: Vehicles are not permitted on the footpath.

name: MINIMUM SPEED 30
description: Blue circle with the number 30.
meaning: Vehicles must travel at 30 km/h or faster.
instruction: Minimum speed is 30 km/h.
rules: Slow vehicles should use another route or lane.

name: GO LEFT
description: Blue circle with a white arrow curving to the left.
meaning: Vehicles must bear left at the junction ahead.
instruction: Bear left at the next junction.
rules: Do not continue straight or turn right at this junction.

name: GO RIGHT
description: Blue circle with a white arrow curving to the right.
meaning: Vehicles must bear right at the junction ahead.
instruction: Bear right at the next junction.
rules: Do not continue straight or turn left at this junction.

name: PASS EITHER SIDE
description: Blue circle with two white arrows pointing left and right.
meaning: Vehicles may pass the obstruction on either side.
instruction: Pass the obstruction on either side.
rules: Both lanes around the central island are open; choose either.

name: STOP
description: Red octagon with the white word STOP.
meaning: Vehicles must come to a complete halt.
instruction: Stop the vehicle completely before proceeding.
rules: Proceed only when the way is clear; give way to cross traffic and pedestrians.

name: GIVE WAY
description: Downward-pointing triangle with a red border.
meaning: Drivers must give priority to traffic on the main road.
instruction: Slow down and give way to other traffic.
rules: Stop if necessary; enter the main road only when it is safe.

name: PRIORITY ROAD
description: Yellow diamond with white and black borders.
meaning: You are on a main road and have the right of way at junctions ahead.
instruction: Continue; you have priority over side roads.
rules: Remain alert: other drivers may still fail to give way.

name: END OF PRIORITY ROAD
description: Yellow diamond crossed by grey diagonal lines.
meaning: The priority (right-of-way) status of this road ends.
instruction: Priority ends; give way as per normal junction rules.
rules: Prepare to slow down and yield at the next junction.

name: PEDESTRIAN CROSSING
description: Red-bordered triangle with a walking person above zebra stripes.
meaning: A pedestrian crossing is ahead.
instruction: Slow down and give way to pedestrians.
rules: Stop for pedestrians already on the crossing; no overtaking near it.

name: SCHOOL AHEAD
description: Red-bordered triangle with an adult and a child.
meaning: A school zone is ahead; children may cross.
instruction: Reduce speed and drive carefully; watch for children.
rules: Horn use and overtaking are discouraged; obey the school-zone speed limit.

name: LEFT CURVE
description: Red-bordered triangle with a curved arrow to the left.
meaning: The road curves to the left ahead.
instruction: Slow down and keep left through the curve.
rules: Do not overtake on curves.

name: RIGHT CURVE
description: Red-bordered triangle with a curved arrow to the right.
meaning: The road curves to the right ahead.
instruction: Slow down and keep left through the curve.
rules: Do not overtake on curves.

name: HAIRPIN BEND
description: Red-bordered triangle with a U-shaped bend arrow.
meaning: A sharp hairpin bend is ahead.
instruction: Reduce speed sharply and drive in low gear.
rules: Sound the horn on blind bends; trucks should take extra care.

name: ROAD NARROWS
description: Red-bordered triangle with two converging curved lines.
meaning: The road becomes narrower ahead.
instruction: Slow down and be ready to give way to oncoming traffic.
rules: Do not overtake; allow oncoming vehicles to pass first when required.

name: SLIPPERY ROAD
description: Red-bordered triangle with a skidding car.
meaning: The road surface may be slippery (wet, oily or icy).
instruction: Slow down and avoid sudden braking or steering.
rules: Increase following distance; use gentle controls.

name: FALLING ROCKS
description: Red-bordered triangle with rocks tumbling down a slope.
meaning: Rocks may fall onto the road ahead.
instruction: Drive carefully and do not stop in this zone.
rules: Watch for debris on the road and be ready to stop.

name: SPEED BREAKER
description: Red-bordered triangle with a hump.
meaning: A speed breaker (hump) is ahead.
instruction: Slow down before the speed breaker.
rules: Crossing at high speed can damage the vehicle and cause loss of control.

name: CROSS ROAD
description: Red-bordered triangle with a plus sign.
meaning: A four-way crossroad is ahead.
instruction: Slow down and look out for crossing traffic.
rules: Follow right-of-way rules; be ready to stop.

name: T-JUNCTION
description: Red-bordered triangle with a T-shaped junction.
meaning: A T-junction is ahead; the road ends and joins another.
instruction: Slow down and prepare to turn or give way.
rules: Check both directions before entering the main road.

name: ROUNDABOUT AHEAD
description: Red-bordered triangle with three circular arrows.
meaning: A roundabout is ahead.
instruction: Slow down and prepare to give way at the roundabout.
rules: Give way to traffic already circulating.

name: TRAFFIC SIGNALS AHEAD
description: Red-bordered triangle with a traffic light.
meaning: Traffic lights are ahead.
instruction: Slow down and be ready to stop at the signal.
rules: Obey the signal colours: red = stop, amber = get ready, green = go.

name: LEVEL CROSSING
description: Red-bordered triangle with a cross.
meaning: A railway level crossing is ahead.
instruction: Slow down and stop if a train is approaching.
rules: Never cross when the barrier is down or the alarm is sounding.

name: MEN AT WORK
description: Red-bordered triangle with a worker and a heap of earth.
meaning: Road works are in progress ahead.
instruction: Slow down and follow the diversion or flagman.
rules: Drive carefully; workers may be on the road.

name: STEEP DESCENT
description: Red-bordered triangle with a downhill slope and '10%'.
meaning: A steep downhill gradient of 10% is ahead.
instruction: Use a low gear and control speed; avoid hard braking.
rules: Do not coast in neutral; overtaking is dangerous.

name: STEEP ASCENT
description: Red-bordered triangle with an uphill slope and '10%'.
meaning: A steep uphill gradient of 10% is ahead.
instruction: Shift to a lower gear and keep a steady speed.
rules: Give way to descending vehicles where the road is narrow.

name: TWO-WAY TRAFFIC
description: Red-bordered triangle with an up arrow and a down arrow.
meaning: Traffic flows in both directions ahead.
instruction: Keep to your side and watch for oncoming vehicles.
rules: Do not overtake unless the road is clearly free.

name: ANIMALS CROSSING
description: Red-bordered triangle with an animal.
meaning: Animals may cross the road ahead.
instruction: Slow down and be ready to stop.
rules: Use the horn gently and never hit or frighten animals.

name: GENERAL DANGER
description: Red-bordered triangle with an exclamation mark.
meaning: An unspecified danger lies ahead.
instruction: Be extra careful and reduce speed.
rules: Look for other signs or road conditions that explain the hazard.

name: UNEVEN ROAD
description: Red-bordered triangle with an uneven road surface.
meaning: The road surface is uneven, bumpy, or has potholes ahead.
instruction: Reduce speed and hold the steering firmly.
rules: Sudden bumps can cause loss of control; keep both hands on the wheel.

name: LOOSE GRAVEL
description: Red-bordered triangle with stones on a road surface.
meaning: Loose gravel on the road ahead may cause skidding.
instruction: Slow down and avoid sudden braking or sharp steering.
rules: Keep a greater following distance to protect from flying stones.

name: FLOOD / WATERLOGGED ROAD
description: Red-bordered triangle with wavy water lines.
meaning: The road ahead may be flooded or waterlogged.
instruction: Slow down and check the water depth before crossing.
rules: Do not enter deeply flooded stretches; your vehicle may stall or be swept away.

name: SIDE ROAD LEFT
description: Red-bordered triangle with a T-shaped road exiting to the left.
meaning: A side road joins the main road from the left ahead.
instruction: Watch for traffic entering from the left.
rules: Slow down; traffic from side roads must give way to you.

name: SIDE ROAD RIGHT
description: Red-bordered triangle with a T-shaped road exiting to the right.
meaning: A side road joins the main road from the right ahead.
instruction: Watch for traffic entering from the right.
rules: Slow down; traffic from side roads must give way to you.

name: STAGGERED JUNCTION
description: Red-bordered triangle with a staggered crossroads symbol.
meaning: A staggered (offset) crossroads junction is ahead.
instruction: Slow down and observe carefully for crossing traffic.
rules: Multiple roads merge in a short distance; proceed with caution.

name: NARROW BRIDGE
description: Red-bordered triangle with a narrow bridge symbol.
meaning: A narrow bridge is ahead; one lane may apply.
instruction: Slow down and give way to oncoming traffic if the bridge is one-lane wide.
rules: Do not race to cross first; large vehicles may need extra space.

name: ACCIDENT PRONE ZONE
description: Red-bordered triangle with a car crash symbol.
meaning: This stretch has a high frequency of road accidents.
instruction: Drive with extra caution; reduce speed and stay alert.
rules: Avoid distractions; maintain safe following distances at all times.

name: DOUBLE BEND
description: Red-bordered triangle with an S-shaped bend arrow.
meaning: Two consecutive curves ahead — first left, then right.
instruction: Reduce speed and keep to the left; do not overtake.
rules: Sudden changes of direction; watch for oncoming traffic on blind segments.

name: RISK OF GROUNDING
description: Red-bordered triangle with a humped bridge and a car scraping the road.
meaning: Low ground clearance vehicles risk grounding on the road feature ahead.
instruction: Low vehicles should approach slowly and at an angle if possible.
rules: Trucks and buses with low clearance should take an alternate route.

name: PARKING
description: Blue square with a white letter P.
meaning: A parking area is available here.
instruction: You may park your vehicle in this area.
rules: Park only within the marked bays; pay the fee if required.

name: HOSPITAL
description: Blue square with a white letter H.
meaning: A hospital is nearby.
instruction: Drive quietly and give way to ambulances.
rules: Horn use is restricted; keep the road clear for emergency vehicles.

name: PETROL PUMP
description: Blue square with a fuel pump.
meaning: A petrol/fuel station is ahead.
instruction: Fuel is available ahead; slow down to enter safely.
rules: Do not smoke or use open flames near the pump.

name: BUS STOP
description: Blue square with a bus.
meaning: A bus stop is located here.
instruction: Give way to buses and pedestrians; do not park here.
rules: Parking at a bus stop obstructs public transport and is an offence.

name: ONE WAY
description: Blue square with a white arrow.
meaning: Traffic is permitted in one direction only.
instruction: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
rules: Driving against the arrow is an offence.

name: DEAD END
description: Blue square with a road ending in a red bar.
meaning: The road ahead has no through way.
instruction: No through road; plan to turn around.
rules: Do not enter unless you have business there.

name: FIRST AID
description: Blue square with a green cross.
meaning: A first-aid post is available here.
instruction: First-aid help is available nearby.
rules: Keep the area clear for emergency use.

name: TELEPHONE
description: Blue square with a telephone handset.
meaning: An emergency/public telephone is available.
instruction: A phone is available here if you need help.
rules: Use it to report accidents or breakdowns.

name: TOURIST INFORMATION
description: Blue square with a white letter i.
meaning: Tourist or visitor information centre nearby.
instruction: Tourist information is available here.
rules: Stop to get maps, guidance, or local attraction details.

name: REST AREA
description: Blue square with a picnic table and tree symbol.
meaning: A rest area for drivers is ahead.
instruction: You may stop to rest, eat, or use facilities here.
rules: Fatigue is dangerous; take a break if tired before continuing your journey.

name: TOLL AHEAD
description: Blue square with a toll barrier and TOLL text.
meaning: A toll plaza is ahead; a fee must be paid to proceed.
instruction: Prepare payment or FASTag and slow down for the toll booth.
rules: Keep your lane; do not jump queues or reverse at the toll plaza.

name: PETROL STATION AHEAD
description: Blue square with a fuel pump and a directional arrow.
meaning: A petrol/fuel station is coming up ahead.
instruction: Fuel station is available shortly ahead on this road.
rules: Look for the turn; do not stop on the main road.

name: NO THROUGH ROAD ON RIGHT
description: Blue square with a road dead-ending to the right.
meaning: The road to the right has no through way.
instruction: The right branch of the junction is a dead end; plan accordingly.
rules: Do not enter the right branch unless you have business there.

name: RED LIGHT
description: Traffic light showing red.
meaning: Vehicles must stop.
instruction: Stop behind the stop line and wait.
rules: Crossing a red light is a punishable offence.

name: AMBER LIGHT
description: Traffic light showing amber (yellow).
meaning: The signal is about to change to red.
instruction: Slow down and prepare to stop.
rules: Stop if it is safe to do so; do not accelerate to beat the light.

name: GREEN LIGHT
description: Traffic light showing green.
meaning: Vehicles may proceed.
instruction: Go, but check that the junction is clear.
rules: Give way to pedestrians and vehicles still clearing the junction.
